boot.extlinux:
default l0
menu title U-Boot menu
prompt 0
timeout 1

label l0
	menu label OpenCCA RK3588 6.12.0-opencca-pmthor-opp3
	linux /boot/vmlinuz-6.12.0-opencca-pmthor-opp3
	initrd /boot/initrd.img-6.12.0-opencca-pmthor-opp3
	fdtdir /usr/lib/linux-image-6.12.0-opencca-pmthor-opp3/
	append root=PARTLABEL=root rootwait isolcpus=1,2,3 maxcpus=2 nohlt cpuidle.off=1 rcupdate.rcu_cpu_st

label l0r
	menu label OpenCCA RK3588 6.12.0-opencca-pmthor-opp3 rescue
	linux /boot/vmlinuz-6.12.0-opencca-pmthor-opp3
	initrd /boot/initrd.img-6.12.0-opencca-pmthor-opp3
	fdtdir /usr/lib/linux-image-6.12.0-opencca-pmthor-opp3/
	append root=PARTLABEL=root rootwait isolcpus=1,2,3 maxcpus=2 nohlt cpuidle.off=1 rcupdate.rcu_cpu_st single
